coaching.headline: Sparrow went 20/3 with Legion dead to him ten times — thirteen won fights and a 26-minute close through Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth.
coaching.team: Three lanes read against us and it never showed: the carry and offlane wins were total, and nearly every fight happened on top of our own pits — Fangtooth at 7, 14 and 19, Mini Prime at 18, Orb Prime at 24, Primal at 25, with 72,306 objective damage against their 8,569. Nobody on our side was caught out alone all game while we picked them off four times. The only notes in a near-perfect film: 13 fight wins with just 6 cashed, and the 21.2 fight was re-taken 3v3 right after two of us had fallen — the one avoidable loss.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 8.7 river teamfight — three of us beating all five of them 5-1 — set the snowball, and from there Sparrow and Serath won fight after fight standing on our own Fangtooth pit.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Sparrow was the whole highlight reel: 20/3/5 with 42032 hero damage and 33225 objective damage, and solo 2-0 stands at our Fangtooth at 13.4 and our Orb Prime at 23.4. Legion finished 0/12 and ten of those were his.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim took an enchanter into mid against a dive assassin read 'theirs all game' and beat her flat — 9/1/7 with four kills on Countess and 25713 hero damage. Winning an unfavored matchup by out-farming and out-trading it is the quiet best performance of the game.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Serath dove clean all night — 12/2/11 with four kills on Feng Mao, 27481 objective damage, and the solo 2-0 at our Fangtooth at 6.7 that started the objective train. Two deaths on a dive assassin is exactly the risk-to-reward the kit wants.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: The Fey. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

bayle.loadout: Nihil (From the Abyss + Adaptive Plating), augment Swift Strikes, crest Judgement
fedBy: Nihil (Eternal): Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.
lines: Kingslayer at rank 2: 125s base, about 83.3s by the end (33% shorter) from 50 ability haste: Mutilator 15, Augmentation 20, Vyzar Carapace 15.
6 takedowns (4 kills, 2 assists) fed: Nihil (Eternal).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Bayle dealt 20,842 hero damage, 24% of their team's, with +137 physical power from items.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
Augmentation (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal (+90% Base Physical Power) Damage On-Hit.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
Adaptive Plating (Eternal minor): Taking damage grants matching Armor (1% per hit, stacks 10x).
Swift Strikes (augment): After casting an ability, Bayle gains 45% Attack Speed for one attack.

Sustain: 16% omnivamp; Vyzar Carapace: Deals 60-170 Damage, based on Level. Gain a 50 (+12%) Shield for 3s.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; 6,529 healing recorded.
Toughness: +575 health; took 40,315 damage, mitigated 24,225, died 7 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Augmentation, Vyzar Carapace, Swift Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Judgement.
Countered? 0 of the 1 players Bayle killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Narbash, GRIM.exe, Serath. We killed Bayle 7 times.
Copy it? Nihil: 49.7% in 171 Bayle offlane games, level with the hero's 49.3%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Kingslayer came back about every 83s instead of 125s by the end (33% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

sparrow.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Endless Hunt, crest Liberator
fedBy: Endless Hunt (augment): Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,617 hero damage a minute, more than 94% of Sparrow carry players this patch (35% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Onixian Quiver, Scattershot.
25 takedowns (20 kills, 5 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 42,032 hero damage, 35% of their team's, with +167 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Legion (level 13: about 85 physical armor, 73 after penetration; took 16,004 physical damage from heroes, 72% of all hero damage they took) and The Fey (level 14: about 82 physical armor, 70 after penetration; took 12,945 physical damage from heroes, 69% of all hero damage they took) that is about 7% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Melee Heroes only: Increase your Total Critical Strike Chance by 25%. Gain 1% Damage Mitigation for every 10% Missing Health.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 4,341 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Onixian Quiver, Scattershot, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Onixian Quiver, Liberator, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Sparrow killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on The Fey. We killed Sparrow 3 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 50.3% in 674 Sparrow carry games, level with the hero's 50.3%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

fedBy: Fallen Grace (passive): Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s. Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 26 minutes, fewer deaths than about 84% of Serath jungle players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Heresy at rank 2: 105s base, about 84s by the end (20% shorter) from 25 ability haste: Spectra 10, Draconum 15.
23 takedowns (12 kills, 11 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Fallen Grace (passive).
Serath dealt 23,365 hero damage, 19% of their team's, with +127 physical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 7,172 healing recorded.
Toughness: +40 physical armor; took 28,986 damage, mitigated 16,452, died 2 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Spectra, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Draconum, Liberator, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 5 players Serath killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on The Fey. We killed Serath 2 times.

Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 48.4% in 1,127 Serath jungle games, below the hero's 49.8%; this 3-item core: 49.8% in 496 games, below the 53% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
